items.quote: 14:1 And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, 14:2 Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.
items.claim: The LORD commanded the Israelites to turn and encamp at a location before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon.
